programs.name: Wartime Veteran/Surviving Spouse Homestead Exemption — Non-SC Totally Disabled

wartimeRequired.quote: Veterans who served on active duty during a recognized war of the U.S. and who are totally disabled by a non-service-connected accident or illness (Category 2)

incomeLimit.quote: Category 2 is income-tested (Schedule I required each year); the 2026 income/value tables live in the Homestead Exemption Information Guide, which was not read in this pass

summary.current: ... Category 4V (100% exemption, no income/value limits) also covers veterans rated below 100% who receive 100% Individual Unemployability; 4V filing is one-time.
summary.correct: Same, confirmed: 4V covers '(ii) assignment of total disability rating for compensation pursuant to 38 C.F.R. 4.16' and is a one-time filing.
summary.quote: have a disability rating of less than 100% but have an Individual Unemployability (IU) Rating that was certified on or before January 1, 2026

programs.effectiveChanges: None for the veteran categories. LB826 (eff. April 15, 2026) added a late-filing route when the VA certification arrives after June 30 (77-3512(1)(d)); LB803 §21 (operative July 18, 2026) re-enacted 77-3506 with the same categories.

programs.name: SC Totally Disabled Veterans and Surviving Spouses — 100% Exempt

type.quote: there shall be exempt from taxation, on any homestead described in subsection (2) of this section, one hundred percent of the exempt amount

ratingRequired.quote: (i) one hundred percent service-connected permanent disability or (ii) assignment of total disability rating for compensation pursuant to 38 C.F.R. 4.16

ptRequired.correct: true for 4V (permanent) with IU as alternate; temporary 100% is Category 7 (same exemption, annual refile)
ptRequired.quote: A veteran ... drawing compensation ... because of one hundred percent service-connected temporary disability (Category 7) ... Application ... shall be required annually

survivingSpouse.quote: An unremarried surviving spouse of a veteran described in subdivision (2)(a) of this section or a surviving spouse of such a veteran who remarries after attaining the age of fifty-seven years

details.current: 100% exempt regardless of homestead value and income level.
details.correct: 100% exempt regardless of homestead value and income; discharge must be honorable or general (under honorable conditions); one-time filing for 4V/4S (Category 7 temporary-100% refiles annually with a fresh VA certification). No Schedule I.
details.quote: Application for exemption under subdivision (2)(a), (b), (d), (e), or (f) of this section shall not be required in any subsequent year

programs.effectiveChanges: LB803 (2026) §21, operative July 18, 2026, re-enacted 77-3506 keeping 4V/4S one-time filing and Category 7 annual filing; the current statute page carries 'Laws 2026, LB803, § 21. Operative Date: July 18, 2026'. LB826 (eff. April 15, 2026) lets a veteran whose VA certification arrived after June 30 file late under 77-3514.01. No dollar or threshold change for TY2026/2027.
programs.note: Lead resolved: LB826 is a filing-deadline relief bill, not a benefit change; Category 7 is the temporary-100% category and gets the identical 100% exemption. Veterans eligible for total exemption under 77-3526 to 77-3528 are excluded from 77-3506 (statutory cross-reference).

programs.name: VA-Purchased/Modified Home — 100% Exempt

type.quote: Paraplegic or Multiple Amputee Veterans whose homestead is substantially contributed to by the Department of Veterans Affairs or the unremarried surviving spouse of such a veteran (Category 5)

survivingSpouse.quote: or the unremarried surviving spouse of such a veteran

programs.note: Category 5 (77-3526 to 77-3528). Not creditable to a rated veteran whose home was not VA-contributed; the engine should not add it on rating alone.

summary: All three rows hold: 4V/4S (100% permanent SC or 38 CFR 4.16 IU, and surviving spouses) is a full exemption with no income or value test and one-time filing; Category 5 VA-contributed homes and income-tested Category 2 are correctly value-less. LB826 (April 2026) only adds a late-filing route for late VA letters and LB803 (July 2026) re-enacted the categories unchanged; Category 7 (temporary 100%, annual refile) should be noted, and the 1.44% tax rate matches Tax Foundation exactly.
